name: Sasaki Takatsuna
source:
Son of Hideyoshi Sasaki, who once served under Yoritomo and Shanao's father, Takatsuna was ordered to follow in his father's footsteps and serve as a vassal to Lord Yoritomo. 

Despite his young age, he has shown a strong ability to serve the Genji on and off the battlefield. His bright and innocent smile is known to bring joy to all those who see it.
